openQuestions: Authoritative GIS extraction is still required for Palmeral/individual huerto boundaries and for any legally precise protected-land geometry; V0 district/zone polygons remain research approximations.
Metric heights in metres and facade/window/balcony rhythms remain weak for most dense apartment families outside local storey evidence such as Carrús Oeste and Los Palmerales.
Current roof/facade/material variation across Ciudad Jardín villas, Sector V/Nuevo Altabix open blocks and Arenales apartment compounds remains under-documented.
San Antón is an active regeneration landscape: 2026 demolition and future housing phases must continue to be tracked as transition/planned evidence rather than one stable family state.
Porfirio Pascual rehabilitation remained technically active in February 2026; completion of all blocks after the project modification was not independently verified in this pass.
Mercado Central rehabilitation was still current work in 2026; December 2026 is a completion objective and final external appearance is not yet treated as present form.
E-49 remains a planning/expansion authority in the baseline source register and is not activated as completed business-park fabric.

Arenales is clearly the municipality’s primary apartment-tourism coastal nucleus, but representative current facade/roof/height samples still need stronger visual evidence before production-level parameterization.
La Marina and El Altet remain intentionally distinct compact/rural/coastal nuclei; finer building-family splits there should wait for evidence that would materially change asset reuse decisions.

Exact current roof/facade geometry of the Alicante–Elche passenger terminal is unresolved in the authoritative text sources used; its plan organization is strong evidence but imagery-derived styling was not promoted to fact.
